decision: No unchanged PPO allocation. Test one diagnostic-only base approach yaw scale 0.5 versus original 1.0 on the latest final, retaining all learned action channels, physics, rewards and thresholds. Reuse exact 16M control, evaluate modified 16M and both controllers on fresh 17M profiles, at most 36000 world controls. This is a command-path causal probe, not evidence for a leg-authority change or policy adoption. No optimization or automatic follow-on allocation.
